title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Rate Card: Young-Renter Daily Fee by Age and Rental Span
content:
**Rate card.** The young-renter daily fee on a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental depends on the renter's age at pickup and the rental's span: a renter aged 22 or younger whose pickup-to-return span is 14 days or more pays the class young-renter fee plus 5.00 USD; a renter aged 22 or younger whose span is shorter pays the class young-renter fee plus 2.50 USD; any older young renter pays the class young-renter fee.

The renter's age is the age at pickup recorded on the reservation; the span is the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, without regard to the times of day.

## Daily fee matrix

| Renter's age at pickup | Span of 14 days or more | Span under 14 days |
|---|---|---|
| 22 or younger | Class fee plus 5.00 USD | Class fee plus 2.50 USD |
| Older than 22 (a young renter) | Class fee | Class fee |

## The matrix worked at each class fee

| Class young-renter fee | Age 22 or younger, span 14 days or more | Age 22 or younger, shorter span | Older young renter |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25.00 USD (Economy, Compact, Intermediate, Full-Size Rental) | 30.00 USD | 27.50 USD | 25.00 USD |
| 30.00 USD (Standard SUV, Minivan Rental) | 35.00 USD | 32.50 USD | 30.00 USD |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- A renter aged 22 on an Economy Rental picked up on the 1st and returned on the 15th: a span of 14 days, so 30.00 USD per fee day. Returned on the 14th: a span of 13 days, so 27.50 USD.
- A renter aged 23 on a Full-Size Rental of any span pays the class fee of 25.00 USD per fee day.
